en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing multiple framed views of a fortified church complex. The upper images are labeled as the north and south sides of the church, with a tower and surrounding wall visible in a rural landscape. At the bottom left is a tall gate tower with a portcullis and people standing nearby, and at the bottom center is a close view of a Romanesque‑style church entrance. Floral graphics decorate the montage. The title at the top identifies the site as the fortified church of Holzmen­gen.
